name: productivity
description: Skills for working more productively with Claude Code. 'handoff' distils the current session into a single self-contained document; 'continue' reads that document in a fresh session and proposes an approved plan to resume the work; 'task-observer' watches task sessions for skill-improvement opportunities and runs skill creation/refinement reviews; 'token-usage' reports token usage (input, output, cache read, cache write) per model across all projects over a time window.
